context: Hiroshi and Kenji discuss solving a critical project problem.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 健次、昨日の問題、原因、何だ。
lines.en: Kenji — yesterday's problem. What was the cause?
lines.style: Clipped, measured opening. No wasted breath. Steady eye contact. Each phrase lands with quiet authority. Not angry, but expecting a complete answer. Lean slightly forward — the posture of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 通信、不具合、です。原因、特定中。
lines.en: Communication failure, sir. We're pinpointing the cause now.
lines.style: Clear, professional report. Shoulders steady. Slight deference in the pacing without sounding evasive. Warm undertone — the tone of someone who takes this seriously and wants him to know it. Meet his gaze.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 解決策、考えろ。今日中だ。
lines.style: Clipped, final-sounding. The word 'today' lands hard but not shouted — quiet urgency. Slight pause before it. This is not a request. Composure intact, but the weight is unmissable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 了解。チームで、対策、まとめます。
lines.en: Understood. We'll have a response ready as a team.
lines.style: Brisk, capable. No hedging. Slight nod on 'understood' — embodying the assurance. Voice steady, rising slightly on the commitment. The tone of someone who just accepted a responsibility and means to deliver it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 客先、影響、最小限に、抑えろ。
lines.en: Keep the impact to the client to an absolute minimum.
lines.style: Each clause deliberate. Slight emphasis on 'minimum' — this matters. No room for approximation. The voice of someone who has managed the fallout before and will not have it happen again on his watch.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、責任、持って、対応します。
lines.en: I will. We'll handle this with full accountability.
lines.style: Direct and earnest. The word 'accountability' carries its weight without drama. Steady tone throughout. This is not a promise he's making lightly — he means to stand behind it. Slight incline of the head — formal respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Noticeably warmer than before — a slight soften in the jaw audible. Brief, genuine. The shift from command to something closer to trust. Not quite warm, but no longer purely transactional. A moment of recognition that he's handed Kenji something real.
